records.context: With ``unmix_partition_plates=True`` and ``unmix_per_plate=True``, one mixed-plate source produces independent calibrated child datasets. Supply ``unmix_plate_calibrations`` as a JSON string mapping every exact plate ID to ``calibration_file``, positive YX ``pixel_size_um``, ``source_context`` containing exact ``plate``, ``time`` and ``z`` IDs, and ``acquisition_compatibility`` set to ``user_asserts_same_channel_gains_exposures_and_linear_response``. Relative optical paths resolve against the original source folder. Each plate has one time/Z context, complete physical-channel controls in the master map, and its own optical assignment and pixel spacing. The assertion concerns controls and targets within that plate, remains unverified, and does not assert equal acquisition settings between plates. Global optical settings and supplied matrix files cannot be combined with partitioning.

records.translation: Með ``unmix_partition_plates=True`` og ``unmix_per_plate=True`` gefur einn uppruni með blönduðum plötum sjálfstæð kvörðuð undirsöfn. Gefið ``unmix_plate_calibrations`` sem JSON-streng sem varpar hverju nákvæmu plötuauðkenni á ``calibration_file``, jákvætt YX ``pixel_size_um``, ``source_context`` með nákvæmum ``plate``, ``time`` og ``z`` auðkennum og ``acquisition_compatibility`` stillt á ``user_asserts_same_channel_gains_exposures_and_linear_response``. Afstæðar ljósfræðislóðir miðast við upprunalegu upprunamöppuna. Hver plata hefur eitt tíma/Z-samhengi, fullbúin viðmið allra eðlisrænna rása í aðalvörpuninni og eigin ljósfræðilega úthlutun og pixlabil. Fullyrðingin varðar viðmið og markgögn innan þeirrar plötu, er óstaðfest og fullyrðir ekki sömu myndöflunarstillingar milli platna. Almennar ljósfræðistillingar og innsendar fylkisskrár má ekki sameina skiptingu.

records.context: Before creating outputs, partitioning captures optical bytes, admits all source headers and batch bounds, and estimates each laboratory microplate's sampled-control matrix sequentially. Unread target values are validated later by the child route before model construction. Canonical control-value fingerprints are compared after assembly; actual NPY file hashes remain the child record's authority. Limits are 8192 microscope fields of view, 16 physical channels and 16 MiB retained metadata, with the ordinary per-microscope field of view, control and batch budgets unchanged. Supported source formats are unchanged; QC supports report or off only. Directory-relative, no-follow and nonblocking descriptor access is required; unsupported hosts refuse before creating outputs.

Ólesin markgildi eru sannreynd síðar á leið undirsafns áður en líkan er smíðað. Staðlað fingrafar viðmiðunargilda er borið saman eftir samsetningu; hakkgildi raunverulegra NPY-skráa eru áfram áreiðanleg heimild færslu undirsafns. Mörkin eru 8192 myndsvið, 16 eðlisrænar rásir og 16 MiB varðveitt lýsigögn, en venjuleg mörk á myndsvið, viðmið og lotur haldast óbreytt. Studd upprunasnið eru óbreytt; QC styður aðeins report eða off. Aðgangur með skráarlýsum miðað við möppur, án þess að fylgja tenglum og án blokkunar, er nauðsynlegur; óstuddir hýslar hafna áður en úttök eru búin til.

records.context: A fresh ``calibrated_plate_batch`` collection directory contains a ``plate_batch.json`` manifest and numbered ``plate_000001`` child datasets. Existing names receive a suffix. The collection is never a measurable dataset; each child retains the ordinary version-1 calibrated signed-cell contract and original global field/source identities. Original files and existing merged data remain untouched. Cancellation or failure preserves completed children and rethrows the original error. Segmentation completion is distinct from aggregate completion, which also requires completed or disabled QC. The opt-in return has ``partitioned=True``, ``plate_results`` with independent resolved ``settings`` and ``output_root`` per child, ``output_roots``, and ``manifest_path``; it has no singular output fallback. With partitioning disabled, the existing return and processing are unchanged.

records.context: optional captured PSF session. Unmixes each whole microscope field of view first when unmixing is on, then processes selected intensities after illumination and before normalization, padding or Cellpose. Stored image data channels stay raw; only the appended labels depend on PSF processing. A calibrated session instead supplies a signed valid extracted image region for a nonnegative segmentation view, restores labels to the reference canvas and stores separate nonquantitative float32 display image data channels in its separate output tree, with signed extracted image regions under ``signed/``. These display image data channels are not Measure inputs; calibrated outputs cannot be resumed and completion requires both durable display and signed files.
records.label: spacr.pipeline_v2.stream_masks_from_stack#8
records.source: optional captured PSF session. Unmixes each whole field first when unmixing is on, then processes selected intensities after illumination and before normalization, padding or Cellpose. Stored image channels stay raw; only the appended labels depend on PSF processing. A calibrated session instead supplies a signed valid crop for a nonnegative segmentation view, restores labels to the reference canvas and stores separate nonquantitative float32 display channels in its separate output tree, with signed crops under ``signed/``. These display channels are not Measure inputs; calibrated outputs cannot be resumed and completion requires both durable display and signed files.

Vistuðu myndrásirnar haldast hráar; aðeins viðbætt merki ráðast af PSF-vinnslu. Kvörðuð lota gefur í staðinn gildan útskurð með formerki fyrir óneikvætt skiptingarsýn, færir merki aftur á viðmiðunarstriga og vistar sérstakar ómegindlegar float32-sýningarrásir í sínu sérstöku úttakstré, með útskurðum með formerki í ``signed/``. Þessar sýningarrásir eru ekki inntak í Measure; kvarðað úttak er ekki hægt að taka upp aftur og bæði sýningarskrár og skrár með formerki þurfa að vera varanlega vistaðar til að ljúka vinnslunni.
